title: Birds are Shit.
excerpt: All animals are equal, but most birds are shit. A democratic ranking of birds from absolute rubbish to top bird.
content_html:
A FAIR AND TOTALLY UNBIASED DEMOCRACY

All animals are equal,
but most birds are shit.

Forget rarity. Forget beauty. Forget whatever Attenborough said. This is all about character. Pigeons have grafted. Vultures provide a public service. Meanwhile some colourful prick in a rainforest has spent six million years evolving a fancy hat.

THE OFFICIAL RECORD

Top 10 shittest birds

The ten birds currently bringing shame upon the entire class Aves.

PASS JUDGEMENT

Rate the evidence

Editorial interference

SHIT 5 TOP BIRD

THE METHODOLOGY

There isn't one.

Since the dawn of ornithology, bird nerds have been obsessed with colourful and showy plumage. Victorian collectors, museums and Darwin all failed to answer the truly democratic question: is this bird actually any good?

As any naturalist who hasn't been infected with the plumage fetish of birding will tell you, most birds are boring. It's time to give a voice to the scavengers, pavement specialists and drab little bastards who are the true underdogs of the birding world.

content_html_zh:
公平且完全公正的民主

所有动物都是平等的，但大多数鸟类都是狗屎。

忘记稀有性。 忘记美丽。 忘记阿滕伯勒所说的一切吧。 这都是关于性格的。 鸽子已经嫁接了。 秃鹫提供公共服务。 与此同时，热带雨林中的一些色彩斑斓的生物花了六百万年的时间进化出了一顶奇特的帽子。

官方记录

十大最糟糕的鸟

这十只鸟，现在让整个鸟族蒙羞。

通过判断

对证据进行评分

编辑干扰

屎 5 顶级鸟

方法论

没有一个。

自鸟类学诞生以来，鸟类爱好者就一直痴迷于色彩鲜艳、艳丽的羽毛。 维多利亚时代的收藏家、博物馆和达尔文都未能回答真正民主的问题：这只鸟真的有什么好处吗？

任何没有受到观鸟羽毛迷恋的博物学家都会告诉你，大多数鸟类都很无聊。 是时候为拾荒者、路面专家和单调的小混蛋发出声音了，他们是观鸟界真正的失败者。
